objective: Test whether one explainable ML filter can select scheduled funding-settlement movement hazards whose same-symbol two-sided OCO payoff remains positive after realistic cost stress.

distinctness.retired_funding_rules: Directional continuation, reversal and fixed-horizon markout after settlement.
distinctness.retired_oco_rules: Unscheduled own-symbol or cross-asset shock activation.
distinctness.this_rule: Scheduled cash-transfer state selects movement hazard; first barrier determines direction.

causality.availability_clock: Tardis local_timestamp in original capture order; exchange timestamp is diagnostic only
causality.source_boundary: unresolved filled positions receive the full structural stop

features: final pre-settlement funding rate in bp
final pre-settlement predicted funding rate in bp
final pre-settlement mark/index premium in bp

model.label: frozen OCO event net return after 18 bp is positive
model.action_rule: arm only when probability times calibration mean positive return plus complement times calibration mean nonpositive return exceeds +5 bp

payoff.trigger_bps: clip(max(8, 2 * prior one-minute volatility bp, 0.08 * prior one-hour range bp), 8, 28)
payoff.double_trigger: -2 * trigger_bps gross and two round-turn costs
payoff.later_funding_charge: sum of absolute final funding rates crossed while open
payoff.global_slot: highest predicted EV at a shared activation timestamp; no new pending/open order until slot release
